name: Set
le_ncard_of_inj_on_range
result.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → α),
  (∀ i < n, f i ∈ s) →
    (∀ i < n, ∀ j < n, f i = f j → i = j) → autoParam s.Finite Set.le_ncard_of_inj_on_range._auto_1 → n ≤ s.ncard
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {s : Set α} {n : ℕ} (f : ℕ → α),
  (∀ i < n, f i ∈ s) →
    (∀ i < n, ∀ j < n, f i = f j → i = j) → autoParam s.Finite Set.le_ncard_of_inj_on_range._auto_1 → n ≤ s.ncard
result.informal_name: Cardinality Lower Bound via Injective Function on Finite Set
result.informal_description: For any finite set $ s $ and natural number $ n $, if there exists a function $ f : \mathbb{N} \to \alpha $ such that $ f $ is injective on the indices $ i < n $ and $ f(i) \in s $ for all $ i < n $, then $ n \leq |s| $, where $ |s| $ denotes the cardinality of $ s $.

name: Set
ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn
result.signature:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (f : α → β),
  (∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) → Set.InjOn f s → autoParam t.Finite Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn._auto_1 → s.ncard ≤ t.ncard
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Set α} {t : Set β} (f : α → β),
  (∀ a ∈ s, f a ∈ t) → Set.InjOn f s → autoParam t.Finite Set.ncard_le_ncard_of_injOn._auto_1 → s.ncard ≤ t.ncard
result.informal_name: Cardinality Inequality from Injection on Finite Sets
result.informal_description: If there is an injective function from a set $ s $ to a finite set $ t $, then the cardinality of $ s $ is less than or equal to the cardinality of $ t $, i.e., $ \#s \leq \#t $.

name: Finite
card_le_of_embedding
result.signature: [Finite β] (f : α ↪ β) : Nat.card α ≤ Nat.card β
result.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Finite β] (f : α ↪ β), Nat.card α ≤ Nat.card β
result.informal_description: If there exists an injective function from a type $\alpha$ to a finite type $\beta$, then the cardinality of $\alpha$ is less than or equal to the cardinality of $\beta$, i.e., $\#\alpha \leq \#\beta$.

name: Finset
card_le_card_of_injOn
result.signature: (f : α → β) (hf : Set.MapsTo f s t) (f_inj : (s : Set α).InjOn f) : #s ≤ #t
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Finset α} {t : Finset β} (f : α → β),
  Set.MapsTo f ↑s ↑t → Set.InjOn f ↑s → s.card ≤ t.card
result.value:
:= by
  classical
    calc
    #s = #(s.image f) := (card_image_of_injOn f_inj).symm
    _ ≤ #t := card_le_card <| image_subset_iff.2 hf
result.informal_name: Cardinality Inequality via Injection on Finite Sets
result.informal_description: If a function $ f $ maps a finite set $ s $ injectively into a finite set $ t $, then the cardinality of $ s $ satisfies $ \#s \leq \#t $.

name: Finset
card_image_of_injOn
result.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {s : Finset α} {f : α → β} [inst : DecidableEq β],
  Set.InjOn f ↑s → (Finset.image f s).card = s.card
result.value: := by simp only [card, image_val_of_injOn H, card_map]
result.informal_name: Injective Function Preserves Cardinality of Finite Set
result.informal_description: For a finite set $ s $ and a function $ f $ that is injective on $ s $, the cardinality of the image of $ s $ under $ f $ is equal to the cardinality of $ s $. Symbolically, $ \#(s.\text{image } f) = \#s $.

name: Real
monotone_rpow_of_base_ge_one
result.type: ∀ {b : ℝ}, 1 ≤ b → Monotone fun x => b ^ x
result.value:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hb with hb | rfl
  case inl => exact (strictMono_rpow_of_base_gt_one hb).monotone
  case inr => intro _ _ _; simp
result.informal_description: For any real number $ b \geq 1 $, the function $ f(x) = b^x $ is monotonic (non-decreasing) on $ \mathbb{R} $.

name: ENat
epow_left_mono
result.type: ∀ {y : ℕ∞}, Monotone fun x => x ^ y
result.value:
:= by
  intro x z x_z
  simp only
  induction y
  · rcases lt_trichotomy x 1 with x_0 | rfl | x_2
    · rw [lt_one_iff_eq_zero.1 x_0, zero_epow_top]; exact bot_le
    · rw [one_epow]; exact one_le_epow (one_le_iff_ne_zero.1 x_z)
    · rw [epow_top (x_2.trans_le x_z)]; exact le_top
  · simp only [epow_natCast, (pow_left_mono _) x_z]
result.informal_name: Monotonicity of Exponentiation in the Base for Extended Natural Numbers
result.informal_description: For any fixed extended natural number $ y $, the function $ f(x) = x^y $ is monotone on the extended natural numbers $ \mathbb{N}^\top $. That is, if $ x \leq x' $, then $ x^y \leq x'^y $.

name: pow_right_monotone
result.signature: (ha : 1 ≤ a) : Monotone fun n : ℕ ↦ a ^ n
result.type: ∀ {M : Type u_3} [inst : Monoid M] [inst_1 : Preorder M] [MulLeftMono M] {a : M}, 1 ≤ a → Monotone fun n => a ^ n
result.value:
:=
  monotone_nat_of_le_succ fun n ↦ by rw [pow_succ]; exact le_mul_of_one_le_right' ha
result.informal_name: Monotonicity of $ a^n $ for $ a \geq 1 $ in a Monoid
result.informal_description: For any element $ a $ in a monoid equipped with a preorder where $ 1 \leq a $, the function $ f(n) = a^n $ for $ n \in \mathbb{N} $ is monotone. This means that for all natural numbers $ n $ and $ m $, if $ n \leq m $, then $ a^n \leq a^m $.

name: pow_right_strictMono₀
result.type:
∀ {M₀ : Type u_2} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder M₀] {a : M₀} [PosMulStrictMono M₀]
  [ZeroLEOneClass M₀], 1 < a → StrictMono fun x => a ^ x
result.value:
:=
  strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ fun n => by
    simpa only [one_mul, pow_succ] using lt_mul_right (pow_pos (zero_le_one.trans_lt h) _) h
result.informal_name: Strict Monotonicity of Exponential Function for Base Greater Than 1
result.informal_description: For any $ a $ with $ a > 1 $, the exponential function $ f(x) = a^x $ is strictly monotonic, meaning that for all $ x < y $, it holds that $ a^x < a^y $.

name: ENNReal
monotone_rpow_of_nonneg
result.signature: {z : ℝ} (h : 0 ≤ z) : Monotone fun x : ℝ≥0∞ => x ^ z
result.type: ∀ {z : ℝ}, 0 ≤ z → Monotone fun x => x ^ z
result.value:
:=
  h.eq_or_lt.elim (fun h0 => h0 ▸ by simp only [rpow_zero, monotone_const]) fun h0 =>
    (strictMono_rpow_of_pos h0).monotone
result.informal_description: For any real number $z \ge 0$, the function $x \mapsto x^z$ is monotone on the extended non-negative real numbers $[0, \infty]$.
